consequences: Later memory must not describe the kit as a containment boundary or its manifest check as a guarantee against the page.
The publication refusal of an unknown or altered kit path remains recorded as what the code does, pending any removal by the Manager or Architect.
context: An earlier reading treated the pinned kit as a boundary and the publication refusal as one of its guarantees. The Architect's amendment 27cb1c00 withdraws L104-B25 and rules the kit to be the presenter's toolbox: it is data a page may use, verified against the manifest so the toolbox is honest, and it confines nothing. The code at 98923b28 still refuses an unknown or altered kit path at publication; that refusal is recorded as what the code does, not as a boundary the page is held inside.
